views.name: chunk_view_0
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.name AS problem,
  ms.name AS source_name,
  ms.version AS version,
  ms.step AS step,
  ms.model AS model,
  ms.test_score AS test_score,
  s.name AS solution_name
FROM
  problem p
JOIN
  model_score ms
  ON ms.name = p.name
LEFT JOIN
  solution s
  ON s.name = p.name AND s.version = ms.version
WHERE
  ms.step IN (1,2,3)

views.name: chunk_view_0_1
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  m.name,
  m.version,
  m.step,
  m.L1_model,
  ms.model AS model_name,
  ms.train_score,
  ms.test_score
FROM model m
LEFT JOIN model_score ms
  ON ms.name = m.name
  AND ms.version = m.version
  AND ms.step = m.step
